metadata.title: Secure Server

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enabling servers to execute institutional workloads under conditional, revocable trust.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server platforms, workloads, control planes, telemetry systems, and trust‑signal consumers.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Zero Trust pattern governing server execution trust through layered signal production, normalization, and consumption.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines server‑side execution trust as a data domain composed of identity, integrity, posture, behavior, and lifecycle signals.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Authoritative control catalog for server trust, execution boundaries, monitoring, and risk management.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust Architecture principles establishing conditional, revocable execution trust for servers.

metadata.remarks: Secure Server composes all server trust patterns into a coherent Zero Trust execution model. It defines how server execution eligibility is established, assessed, and revoked through normalized trust signals without granting implicit privilege or permanent trust.

components.title: Server Core
components.description: Defines baseline execution eligibility and non‑equivalence boundaries for servers.

components.title: Server Attestation and Trust
components.description: Produces cryptographic integrity and provenance signals for server platforms and workloads.

components.title: Server Configuration and Baseline
components.description: Defines desired configuration state and drift signals for servers.

components.title: Server Patch and Vulnerability Posture
components.description: Produces vulnerability and patch posture signals to inform risk.

components.title: Server Runtime Protection
components.description: Produces runtime behavior and anomaly signals during server execution.

components.title: Server Monitoring and Response
components.description: Provides observation, detection, alerting, and response coordination.

components.title: Server Lifecycle Signaling
components.description: Produces lifecycle state signals that enable trust revocation and execution termination decisions.

components.title: Server Telemetry Normalization
components.description: Normalizes heterogeneous server telemetry into decision‑grade trust and risk signals.
